statements.t: There can be no assurance that future developments affecting us will be those that we have anticipated.
References in this section to our future plans that indicate the timing of when we expect such plans to be completed by a certain year mean at any point during that year.

If the proposal is approved, we intend to implement the reverse stock split promptly following the annual meeting if our Board of Directors determines that a decrease in the number of shares of Class A Common Stock outstanding is likely to improve the trading price of our Class A Common Stock and is necessary to help maintain our listing on the NYSE.
We expect to sustain substantial operating expenses, without generating sufficient revenues to cover expenditures, for several years.

Our historical results may not be indicative of our future results for reasons that may be difficult to anticipate and our ability to generate revenue in the future that is sufficient to achieve profitability will depend largely on the successful development of our products and services.

Our development of NDAA-compliant manufacturing capacity for drone cells is intended to position us to capture new business from the U.S. government and defense-related customers, which we believe could be a driver of future revenue growth.

We recently completed the ramp up of the manufacturing capacity of our Chungju, South Korea drone cell line to an installed capacity of one million NDAA-compliant cells per year and announced plans to further expand the line to an installed capacity of three million NDAA-compliant cells per year by the end of the second quarter of 2027.

If we are unable to achieve commercial-scale production or if demand for NDAA-compliant drone cells does not materialize as expected, we could experience underutilization of assets and negative impacts on cash flows.

We expect that successful adoption of Molecular Universe, both as a software product and as an integrated component of our hardware and software offerings, could increase revenues and improve gross margins over time.
If adoption is slower than anticipated or if competing platforms gain traction, our ability to achieve revenue growth and profitability could be adversely affected.

Our strategic shift away from in-house manufacturing of certain battery materials, and the announcement of a fully consolidated variable interest entity with Hisun to produce novel materials at commercial scale, is expected to reduce capital intensity and accelerate time-to-market for new products.
We anticipate that this approach will allow us to scale more efficiently and address a broader customer base, which could positively impact future revenues.

Gross profit margin has been and will continue to fluctuate over time affected by a variety of factors, including the average sales price of our product and service offerings and changes in our mix of revenue between ESS products, drone batteries, battery materials and service offerings to automotive OEMs and other manufacturers .

If we need additional funding beyond these existing short- to medium-term sources of liquidity, or if we are not able to fund our operations from cash flows generated from anticipated product sales and service offerings, we expect that we will need to raise additional funds.
